title: Microsoft Internet Attack Surface
descriptionMarkdown: Microsoft Internet Attack Surface data connector gives richer insights into security events by supplementing details about externally exposed assets and their attack surfaces. Data from this connector helps identify and monitor internet-facing resources, vulnerabilities, and potential security risks across your organization's external attack surface. [Learn about Microsoft Internet Attack Surface.](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/external-attack-surface-management/overview)

instructionSteps.title: Connect Microsoft Internet Attack Surface data connector to your Microsoft Sentinel
instructionSteps.description:
- If you have a Microsoft Defender EASM workspace, this will be used as the source-of-truth for your assets.
- If you have more than one Microsoft Defender EASM workspace, the oldest workspace will be used.
- If you have no Microsoft Defender EASM workspace, a best-effort approach will be made to automatically determine your attack surface based on internal tenant telemetry.
